name: Kadam Singh
contribution: Kadam Singh led a local rebellion in the Meerut region during the 1857 uprising and challenged Company authority beyond the initial sepoy outbreak.
context: His activity belongs to the rural Meerut theatre, where local landholders, armed groups, and displaced authorities responded to the collapse of Company control after the outbreak.
impact: Kadam Singh shows how the 1857 rebellion spread from military cantonments into surrounding countryside and became a struggle over local authority as well as imperial rule.
highlight: Local rebel leader who organized resistance in the Meerut region during 1857.
seoTitle: Kadam Singh: Meerut Region Rebel Leader of 1857
seoDescription: Learn about Kadam Singh and the local rural resistance to East India Company authority in the Meerut region during 1857.
shortAnswer: Kadam Singh was a local rebel leader who organized resistance in the Meerut region during the 1857 uprising.
